system.description:
You swing your weapon in a circle around you, striking at all around you and making it hard to even stand near you. All creatures withing a radius equal to your weapons range must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they take your [Weapons damage] + 2d6 damage and they fall Prone. On a successful save they take half damage and no further effects.

Chain 1: Prone creatures must spend their full movement to stand back up.

Chain 2: Prone creatures must spend their Action to stand back up.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
